details.description: Indulge in the vibrant, thick, and glossy delight of Cremica Tomato Ketchup. Crafted with the finest, hand-picked tomatoes, this ketchup boasts a perfect blend of sweet, tangy, and salty flavours that will elevate any dish. The easy-to-use Squeasy packaging offers convenient storage and a fun, kid-friendly appeal. Versatile and multi-purpose, this ketchup pairs beautifully with sandwiches, burgers, pizzas, samosas, and more, adding a delightful twist to your favourite snacks and meals. Suitable for vegetarians, Cremica Ketchup is a trusted brand loved by millions, offering a scrumptious and satisfying culinary experience.

details.description:
Cremica Schezwan Sauce is your all-in-one kitchen
companion – a multi-purpose cook, dip, and spread that adds a bold twist to
every meal. Packed with fiery, spicy, tangy, and garlicky flavours, it
instantly elevates your favourite dishes with a punch of taste. Use it in
stir-fries for that perfect restaurant-style zing, as a dip for momos, spring
rolls, and French fries, or spread it on sandwiches, wraps, and rolls to give
them an irresistible kick. Versatile and flavourful, Cremica Schezwan Sauce is
the ultimate way to spice up your everyday cooking. Cook, dip, and spread the
flavour of fire!
